## About
Puzzuoli's Mr. Muffler is a local small business owned and operated by Chris and Jim Puzzuoli. Both are lifelong Dearborn residents, and both are fully licensed and certified auto technicians.
We do mostly undercar work on cars of all makes and models. You'll get the courtesy and respect you deserve and a fair price on your repairs. We never try to upsell you. We focus on what you actually need.
Stop in at W Warren Ave and see Chris, Jim and the rest of the crew. Drivers have given us 4.6 stars across 148 Google reviews.

## Services
- Undercar services: Alignments, brakes, shocks, struts, belts, hoses, mufflers and more, for all makes and models.
- Brake work: We carry Monroe and Raybestos brake parts.
- Tire Repair / Replacement / Rotation: Cooper tires in house, and we can get all brands.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars of all makes and models.

Q: Who runs the shop?
A: Chris and Jim Puzzuoli own and operate it. Stop in and say hello.

Q: Are you hiring?
A: Yes. Stop by the shop or give us a call at 313-584-8770.
